meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会写小型脚本驱动浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网站。页面状态在多次脚本执行之间保留,可分步完成一个流程。
howto.when: 当你要求做浏览器操作时接管,例如打开网站、填写表单、截图等;说出 “go to [url]”、“click on” 这类话也会触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把标题和地址打印出来
say.note: 会在服务器上创建名为 example 的页面

say.text: 帮我在这个登录表单里填上账号密码并提交
say.note: 脚本先定位元素再填入

say.text: 给当前页面截一张全页截图
say.note: 截图存到 tmp/ 目录

howto.what_en: Claude writes small scripts that drive a Chromium browser: opening pages, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, scraping data and testing sites. Page state persists between script runs, so a workflow can be done step by step.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for browser actions such as opening a website, filling a form or taking a screenshot, or when you say things like "go to [url]" or "click on".

say_en.text: Open example.com and print the title and URL
say_en.note: Creates a page named example on the server

say_en.text: Fill in the account and password on this login form and submit
Take a full-page screenshot of the current page
